banner: TEMPLATE - NO REAL RECORDINGS INCLUDED - NO WEEK 7 ACCURACY RESULT YET. Copy this file OUTSIDE the repository, replace every <placeholder>, remove the "template" flag and the TEMPLATE- prefixes, then run: python -m evaluation.week7_voice_eval validate --manifest <file>
notes: Rules: audio is 16 kHz / mono / 16-bit PCM WAV stored OUTSIDE the repository (never copied into it); a real or possibly-real human recording needs an explicit consent_reference (UNKNOWN is rejected); only recording_origin SYNTHETIC uses consent_reference NOT_APPLICABLE and speaker_code NOT_APPLICABLE; reference_command_text is the COMMAND ONLY (no wake phrase); non-speech controls have an empty reference_command_text; split is DEV or HELDOUT (calibrate on DEV only). Optional fields per entry: wake_end_sample, speech_start_sample, speech_end_sample (16 kHz sample indices, end exclusive), human_review (MATCH / PARTIAL / MISMATCH / EMPTY / NOT_REVIEWED), audio_sha256, conversion {description, original_filename, original_sha256}.
